linkedin_angles.draft:
California Community Colleges wants AI funded to tune of $195M

In its 2027-28 state budget proposal, the public system emphasized the importance of a unified adoption of artificial intelligence practices and policies.

The AI conversation is starting to move from novelty toward implementation: governance, training, workload, equity, and the points where human judgment still matters.

For community colleges, the question is whether the implementation capacity matches the ambition.

Source: https://www.highereddive.com/news/california-community-colleges-wants-ai-funded-to-tune-of-195m/831531/
